title: Photos on crashes, parts and batteries
goal: A photo sent in Telegram or the dashboard is kept with the record it shows
acceptance: Stored locally with size and type checks; private by default
Shown with the crash, part or battery
privacy: Owner fleet and kitchen data stay local-only; tests use invented batteries, drones and recipes.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-14 from the owner request at agent speed (harness 8.14.3: implementation steps 0.75 h). Not a measurement. Re-estimated 2026-11-15 from 0.75 h to 0.5 h: `node tools/work-items.mjs calibrate` since 2026-11-14 shows F-007-T04, F-050-T02 and F-054-T03 (bounded product steps of the same shape) at 0.08-0.17x their baselines (stated actuals, n=3); security, distributed and isolation steps not revised.
